title: These renders show what Apple might have planned for the successor to the iPhone X (AAPL)
text: These renders show what Apple might have planned for the successor to the iPhone X (AAPL) By Edoardo Maggio Jan 23, 2018, 8:38 am 16 pts Sometime later this Autumn, Apple is expected to unveil its new iPhone lineup. It's not clear whether the company will stick to three models, like in 2017, or go back to two as it did in previous years.
